pretreatment: post-deposition heat treatment at 400 °C in an O2 gas flow for 5 min
evidence: The films were deposited on 3.5 × 3.5 cm2 borosilicate substrates. The as-deposited films were crystalline, but to enhance the crystallinity, a post-deposition heat treatment was carried out at 400 °C in a rapid-thermal-annealing furnace (RTA; PEO 601 ATV Technologie GmbH) in an O2 gas flow for 5 min.
